title: A2v10 metadata.json (report)
description: A report: a window into a surface, no data of its own. Declares the SUBSET that may be asked, not a query - the client picks one inside it at runtime. surface >= subset >= query: the first is checked at build, the second at runtime. Not here: SQL, presentation, captions, the user's saved choice. Irregular report -> eject to a handler. Enum values are written as listed, in camelCase.

then.description: A report over a ledger groups by the account and measures the sum - both the ledger's baseline, so there is no subset to offer: only 'filters'.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy. Where the model writes down what it must know about this endpoint - its rules and the reasons for them - so the next session finds them here.

type.description: Form of the answer. 'turnover' - opening balance, movements of the period, closing balance, in the groupings picked. 'trialBalance' - the trial balance of a ledger: per account, opening balance, debit and credit turnover, closing balance, each balance a debit/credit pair laid out by the account's NormalBalance; nothing to pick but the period and the filters. 'chessboard' - the turnover of a ledger in account correspondence: debit accounts down, credit accounts across, read from the debit legs; nothing to pick but the period and the filters.

surface.description: The shape this report reads: a journal for 'turnover' ('/journal/stock'), a ledger for 'trialBalance' and 'chessboard' ('/ledger/national'). Not 'table' or 'storage': a report owns no rows and inherits no declaration.

groups.description: Dimensions offered for grouping, resolved into the surface at build. Order here is order in the taskpad - there is no 'order' key.

filters.description: Dimensions offered for filtering. Resolved and ordered as 'groups'.

data.description: Measures offered for display, resolved into the surface at build.

defaults.description: Ticked on open. Each name repeats one from the list it belongs to; absent there - refused at build. No 'filters' here: a filter opens empty.
